common.tagline: Official document verification, handled end to end

footer.tagline: Official document verification through trusted government authorities.

landing.title: Verify your official documents with confidence
landing.subtitle: Submit your educational, professional or security certificates and we will verify them directly with the issuing authority. All you need to start is an email address.
landing.secondaryCta: I already have an order number
landing.howItWorksHeading: From email to verified document in three steps

services.title: Three verification tracks, one platform
services.eduBody: Bachelor, Master, and Doctorate degrees verified with universities and ministries of higher education.
services.proBody: Experience letters and professional credentials confirmed with issuing employers and chambers.
services.secBody: Criminal record extracts and military service certificates issued and verified with interior ministries.

features.title: Everything about your verification, in the open
features.timelineBody: Every comment, status change, and file event in one activity feed. Nothing happens behind your back.
features.walletBody: Every top-up, payment, and refund is a ledger entry you can audit. Refund pending applications in one tap.
features.i18nBody: Ten languages including Arabic with true right-to-left layouts across the wizard, tables, and timeline.
features.securityBody: Cryptographically generated order numbers and passwords. Your order is scoped, isolated, and rate-limited.

cta.title: Your documents, verified by the source.
cta.body: Start with just your email address. You will receive your order credentials within a minute.

steps.registerBody: No forms, no passwords to invent. We send you a secure order number and access key instantly.
steps.applyBody: A guided wizard walks you through personal details, document type, authority, and required files.
steps.trackBody: Follow every status change in a live timeline, chat with reviewers, and download stamped results.

register.title: Create your order
register.subtitle: We only need your email address. Your order number and password will be sent there.
register.languageHint: We will send your email and updates in this language.
register.successBody: We have sent your order number and password to {{email}}.
register.successSpam: If it has not arrived within a minute, please check your spam folder.
register.devCredentials: Development mode — your credentials are shown below because email delivery is disabled.

login.title: Follow your order
login.subtitle: Use the order number and password from your email.
login.noOrder: Do not have an order yet?
login.invalidCredentials: That order number and password do not match. Please check your email and try again.
login.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

setup.title: Set up your order
setup.subtitle: Choose where your documents will be verified and the currency you will pay in.
setup.countryHint: This determines which authorities and services are available to you.
setup.currencyHint: Your wallet will be opened in this currency and cannot be changed later.
setup.contactNameHint: Who we should speak to about this order.
setup.contactPhoneHint: Choose the country code, then enter the number without it.
setup.warningBody: Once your wallet is open, the verification country and currency are fixed for this order.
setup.successBody: Your wallet has been opened in {{currency}}. You can now create your first application.

validation.contactNameTooLong: The name must be 200 characters or fewer.
validation.contactPhoneRequired: Enter the contact person's phone number.
validation.contactPhoneInvalid: Enter 4 to 15 digits, without the country code.

review.subtitle: Check everything below, then save it as a draft or submit it for payment.

dashboard.title: My applications
dashboard.empty: You have not created any applications yet.
dashboard.emptyHint: Start one and we will guide you through it step by step.
dashboard.bulkPayHint: Tick the applications that are awaiting payment, then pay them together in a single wallet transaction. Drafts must be completed and submitted before they can be paid.

payment.subtitle: The following applications will be paid from your wallet in one transaction.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.depositIntro: Tell us how much you are transferring. An administrator confirms it and credits your wallet.
wallet.withdrawIntro: Tell us how much you would like paid back to you.
wallet.withdrawHoldNotice: The amount is set aside as soon as you send the request, so it cannot be spent while it is reviewed. Cancelling returns it to your balance.
wallet.depositNotePlaceholder: Anything we should know about this transfer
wallet.withdrawNotePlaceholder: Where the funds should be sent…
wallet.exceedsBalance: You cannot withdraw more than your balance of {{balance}}.

wallet.withdrawSubmitted: Your payout request was sent. The amount is on hold until it is reviewed.
wallet.pendingNotice: You have requests awaiting a decision.
wallet.testFundsBody: This environment allows wallet top-ups without an administrator, so payment can be tried end to end.
wallet.noPaymentMethods: No payment methods are available for your order yet. Please contact support.
wallet.chooseAccountHint: Pick the one you transferred to, so we can match your payment.
wallet.proofHint: A receipt or screenshot. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
wallet.approvalNotice: Our team checks every top-up before the money appears in your wallet.
wallet.requestsSubtitle: Open one to see what you sent.
wallet.noProof: No documents were uploaded with this request.
wallet.awaitingDeposit: Our team is checking your transfer. The money appears in your wallet once it is confirmed.
wallet.awaitingWithdrawal: Our team is reviewing your payout request. The amount stays on hold until it is decided.
wallet.cancelConfirmBody: This withdraws the request. You can always send a new one.
wallet.choosePaymentType: How would you like to pay?
